_about: Worn clothing (Kathleen, goal 1f). One row per wearable item: builder (src/client/worn_look.gd), colour, layer (0 base, 1 clothing, 2 outer, 3 pack; each layer stands 1.5 cm further out), optional params. Pieces hang on named body bones (BoneAttachment3D); a new wearable = one row here. tools/validate_items.gd checks every item with a slot has a row and every row names a known builder.
